## §5.4 MASTER GATES
MASTER TRANSCRIPTION PROTOCOL: asr_dual.py on the master's own audio —
faster-whisper large-v3 + distil-large-v3, float32-array feed,
vad_filter=True, condition_on_previous_text=False, word_timestamps=True
(work/qc/master_asr.json) + Rumble-2-Flash (non-Whisper architecture)
full-master pass + RMS adjudication of every disagreement span.

F-9 SPEAKER-ATTRIBUTED TRANSCRIPT (master's own audio; picture
summaries interleaved; speakers attributed from the picture record):
- U1 (0–10s) [Peach points through the glass at the red umbrella on
  June's shelves, hand on the bell; June seated, unimpressed]
  PEACH 1.17–2.67: "That's mine! The red one!"
  JUNE 4.55–6.57: "It was blue 30 seconds ago."
  PEACH 7.91–9.21: "Rain does that."
- U2 (10–20s) [June slides the form; the Peach scribbles head-down;
  June holds the form up and reads it back]
  JUNE 10.41–14.79: "The form. Color. Handle. What's taped underneath."
  JUNE 16.07–19.13: "Very umbrella. That's not a description, that's a wish."
- U3 (20–30s) [June ducks and hauls the giant red beach umbrella up
  onto the counter; the Peach reaches; June's hand stops the pole]
  JUNE 21.09–23.77: "Red. Beach edition. Yours?"
  PEACH 25.11–26.41: "I could make it work."
  JUNE 27.43–28.95: "That's a no with confidence."
- U4 (30–40s) [the Peach slides the sunglasses across; they come back
  in silence; the Peach bows its head]
  PEACH 30.0–34.3: "For your trouble. Designer. A dog designed them, but still."
  [silence 34.3–36.8 — the return beat; no words]
  PEACH 36.75–38.45: "My dignity's in that umbrella."
- U5 (40–50s) [thunder; the Peach still, head bowed; June stands,
  takes the form to the back shelves and reads it]
  PEACH 41.16–48.89: "Okay, so technically... it was my mom's. Bus pass
  taped under the handle. Yellow ribbon."
- U6 (50–60s) [June returns with the battered red duck-handle
  umbrella and hands it over FIRST; the Peach opens it indoors; June
